title: Equity And Trust Ii
modules: Constitution Of Trusts And The Exceptions
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bit an uneasy task and classification varies according to the classifiers."
Classifying trusts is a bit an uneasy task and classification varies according to the classifiers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a unique feature which the law of trusts can be put into."
Trusts in favour of creditors are a unique feature which the law of trusts can be put into.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a gift made in contemplation of death."
Donatio mortis causa is a gift made in contemplation of death.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a reflection of the purpose and object of the trusts."
The classifications of trusts are a reflection of the purpose and object of the trusts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a corporation sole with perpetual seal and his office is one created by statute."
The Administrator-General is a corporation sole with perpetual seal and his office is one created by statute.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the life time of a person in existence plus twenty one years."
The period is the life time of a person in existence plus twenty one years.
fib: ______ is referred to as a testamentary trust and the terms and conditions of such trusts are contained in the Will creating it.
A trust created by a Will is referred to as a testamentary trust and the terms and conditions of such trusts are contained in the Will creating it.
______ is the bedrock of the trustee's duties.
The duty to distribute is the bedrock of the trustee's duties.
______ are a class of trusts imposed by law (equity) irrespective of the intention to create a trust.
Constructive trusts are a class of trusts imposed by law (equity) irrespective of the intention to create a trust.
______ is an important class of trusts as a result of the public benefit they offer.
Charitable trust is an important class of trusts as a result of the public benefit they offer.
______ means and wealthy people can create or establish a trust for their own benefit or for the benefit of others.
People with limited means and wealthy people can create or establish a trust for their own benefit or for the benefit of others.
______ is concerned with preventing the legal owner of a property from escaping with an unconscionable conduct.
Constructive trust is concerned with preventing the legal owner of a property from escaping with an unconscionable conduct.
